Sedative Hypnotics - AZM 
 
  
  
Prior Authorization Guideline 
 
  
Guideline ID 
GL-629212  
Guideline Name 
Sedative Hypnotics - AZM  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
6/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Preferred: generic ramelteon; Non-Preferred: Brand Rozerem  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to a trial of at least two of the following 
preferred agents:  
• 
Eszopiclone (Generic Lunesta)  
• 
Zolpidem/Zolpidem ER (Generic Ambien/Ambien CR)  
• 
Temazepam 15/30mg capsules (Generic Restoril)  


=== PDF PAGE 1558 ===
Page 1558 
 
AND 
 
2 - For Brand Rozerem requests ONLY, patient must have tried and failed generic ramelteon  
 
Product Name:Non-Preferred Drugs: Brand Ambien, Brand Ambien CR, Edluar, Brand 
Intermezzo, generic zolpidem SL tablets, Zolpimist, Belsomra, Dayvigo, estazolam, 
flurazepam, Brand Halcion, generic triazolam, Brand Lunesta, Quviviq, Brand Restoril, 
generic temazepam 7.5 mg and 22.5 mg capsules, Brand Silenor, generic doxepin, generic 
zaleplon  
Diagnosis 
Non-Preferred  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to a trial of at least two of the following 
preferred agents:  
• 
Eszopiclone (Generic Lunesta)  
• 
Zolpidem/Zolpidem ER (Generic Ambien/Ambien CR)  
• 
Temazepam 15/30mg capsules (Generic Restoril)  
 
Product Name:Brand Ambien, generic zolpidem, Brand Ambien CR, generic zolpidem ER, 
Edluar, Brand Intermezzo, generic zolpidem SL tablets, Zolpimist, Belsomra, Dayvigo, 
estazolam, flurazepam, Brand Halcion, generic triazolam, Brand Lunesta, generic 
eszopiclone, Quviviq, Brand Restoril, generic temazepam, Brand Rozerem, generic 
ramelteon, Brand Silenor, generic doxepin, generic zaleplon  
Diagnosis 
Reject 75: Greater than 1 hypnotic in 30 days  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The requested medication is being used to adjust the dose of the drug  


=== PDF PAGE 1559 ===
Page 1559 
 
OR 
 
2 - The requested medication will be used in place of the previously prescribed drug, and not 
in addition to it  
 
OR 
 
3 - The requested medication dosage form will be used in place of the previously prescribed 
medication dosage form, and not in addition to it  
 
OR 
 
4 - The physician attests they are aware of the multiple sedative hypnotics prescribed to the 
patient and feels treatment with both medications is medically necessary (Document rationale 
for use)  
 
Product Name:Brand Ambien, generic zolpidem, Brand Ambien CR, generic zolpidem ER, 
Edluar, Brand Intermezzo, generic zolpidem SL tablets, Zolpimist, Belsomra, Dayvigo, 
estazolam, flurazepam, Brand Halcion, generic triazolam, Brand Lunesta, generic 
eszopiclone, Quviviq, Brand Restoril, generic temazepam, Brand Rozerem, generic 
ramelteon, Brand Silenor, generic doxepin, generic zaleplon  
Diagnosis 
Requests for Patients less than 6 years of age  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - The patient is unresponsive to other treatment modalities, unless contraindicated (i.e. 
other medications or behavioral modification attempted)  
 
AND 
 
2 - The physician attests that the requested medication is medically necessary. (Document 
rationale for use)
